mapper.insert: INSERT INTO px_push_device (user_id, client_id, platform, app_version, update_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{clientId}, #{platform}, #{appVersion}, now(), now()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform = #{platform}, app_version = #{appVersion}, update_time = now()
mapper.delete: delete from px_push_device where update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
